  WHY: The shell script will fail to expand `${ISSUE_BODY}`, resulting in an empty string being passed to `sed`; the orchestrator-child parent lookup will always produce an empty `SMOKE_TRACKING_NUM`, causing `IS_SMOKE_PARENT` to incorrectly remain `false`.
